units.titles: Payable Vulnerability in Multicall Implementation Resulting In The Bypassing Of Checks Imposed By _msgValue
units.known_address_notes: Zokyo Dec-2024 review of Haven1 system contracts; the high finding is the payable Multicall `_msgValue` bypass. Haven1 is its own EVM L1 (chainid 8811, rpc.haven1.org). Docs publish only token addresses (ProofOfIdentity NFT, WH1, ESH1, hUSDC/hUSDT/hETH/hcbETH/hsETH, cbBTC) plus the Ethereum H1/hsETH tokens; the audited Multicall/protocol contract is not listed. On-chain check on chain 8811 failed from this host: rpc.haven1.org returns Cloudflare 'error code 1016' and explorer.haven1.org HTTP 530

units.titles: `StakedToken` is vulnerable to share inflation attack via donation
units.known_address_notes: Chain resolved from increment-protocol hardhat.config.ts (mainnet.era.zksync.io, chainId 324). Audited finding is in peripheral-contracts StakedToken (SafetyModule suite: SafetyModule/StakedToken/SMRewardDistributor/AuctionModule). That repo publishes no deployment addresses and zkScan/Etherscan 324 lookups are unavailable, so the exact StakedToken instance is unpublished -> PARTIAL. Protocol core (ClearingHouse / PerpMarketFactory) confirmed live on zkSync Era with non-empty code.

units.titles: Incorrect baselineBalance update allows revenue distribution to be manipulated
units.known_address_notes: Macro Oct-2025 review of contracts/access/AccessControlled.sol, interfaces/IClankerTokenizerV3_1_0.sol and tokenizers/* for repo pool-fans/clanker-revenue-shares-tokenizer @23696f1e→9bd282f9. Repo is now 404/private. Project token FANS on Base (verified ClankerToken) is the only on-chain anchor; the audited RevenueSharesTokenizer instance itself has no published address and Base Blockscout API returns 403 from this environment.
